items.markdown:
To get a Destination Thailand Visa (DTV), you must qualify under remote work, soft power activities (like Muay Thai or cooking school), or as a dependent. Then, prepare financial proof of 500,000 THB and apply online through the official [Thai e-Visa Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).[[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/visa/dtv-visa)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYtIlfZssqU&t=210)[[3]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/thailand-digital-nomad-visa-or-how-to-apply.html)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q_n7NpDqIAw)[[5]](https://dtvthaivisa.com/)

Eligibility Categories

- **Workation:** For digital nomads, freelancers, and remote workers employed by foreign companies outside Thailand.
- **Thai Soft Power:** For attending approved courses like Muay Thai, Thai cooking, medical treatment, or professional training.
- **Dependents:** For legal spouses and children under 20 years old accompanying the primary DTV holder.[](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/thailand-digital-nomad-visa-or-how-to-apply.html) [[1]](https://www.fragomen.com/insights/thailand-digital-nomad-visa-or-how-to-apply.html)[[2]](https://dtv.in.th/country/united-kingdom)[[3]](https://dtvthaivisa.com/)[[4]](https://itsbetterinthailand.com/destination-thailand-visa-dtv-digital-nomad-visa/)[[5]](https://www.expatriatehealthcare.com/thailand-digital-nomad-visa/)

Required Documents

- **Passport:** Biodata page copy and a recent passport-sized photo.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa)
- **Financial Proof:** Bank statements showing a minimum balance of 500,000 THB (approx. £11,000 or $14,000 USD) held consistently for the last 3 months.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa)
- **Employment or Activity Proof:** Employment contract, professional portfolio, or acceptance letter from an approved Thai institution or hospital.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) 
- **Location Evidence:** Proof of current residence or address in the country where you submit your application.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) 

Application Process

- **Prepare and Check:** Ensure you meet the minimum age requirement of 20 years old for self-supporting applicants.
- **Submit Online:** Register on the Thai e-Visa Portal , select the DTV category, and upload all digital files.
- **Pay Fees:** Pay the local non-refundable processing fee, which is roughly £300 if applying in the UK.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYtIlfZssqU&t=210) 

For tips on how to get the paperwork and application steps just right:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn3.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRdKSZj7NnyTcQbTmQEpkJXTTKc8kLt1xoAIFCpkTZXpP81vMJd)
